subject: Pilot packaging & blended-rate clearance request (VP/CFO sign-off)
messages:
From: Daniel Park <dpark@novahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot ask — blended rate + packaging question

Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the internal feasibility review and NovaHealth is interested in a 3-month pilot (approx 4M tokens/month) to evaluate inference cost and latency for our clinical summarization flow. A couple of asks before we proceed to PoC SOW: 

- Can you provide a blended token rate for the pilot that accounts for mix (short vs long seqs)? We need predictable per-token cost for budgeting.
- We need a packaging option that separates hosted API for dev + dedicated pool for production inference (we expect bursty nights). Can that be bundled under one SOW with staged billing?
- Any onboarding credit or pilot discount you can extend would help speed procurement signoff.

Attached is a short RFP excerpt. Can you send a proposed SOW with suggested commercial terms? Procurement will need to loop in their finance folks.

Regards,
Daniel Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
NovaHealth

Attachment: NovaHealth_Pilot_RFP.pdf (application/pdf, 132KB)

Daniel —

Appreciate the clarity. I'm drafting a recommended SOW and commercial proposal now. High level response:

- We can offer a pilot-blended token rate that applies to the whole pilot term (calculated on historical token mix assumptions) with an explicit token band for overages.
- Packaging: we can include a staged delivery (hosted API for dev + Dedicated pool for production) in one SOW with milestone-based billing.
- For a 3-month pilot at expected volume, I can request a 20% starter credit applied as an onboarding offset (subject to approval).

I'm escalating to finance and commercial operations to confirm the credit and blended-rate structure. I'll include Markus and Ben for exec clearance since this looks like a bespoke commercial. Expect a follow-up within 24 business hours with a proposed term sheet and suggested DocuSign link.

Best,

Team — forwarding Jordan's summary and the RFP. Quick read: NovaHealth is a high-strategic lead (regional health system). Jordan suggests a 20% onboarding credit and a blended pilot rate. Financials below (estimated):

- Estimated token cost at our list rates: $22k/mo
- Proposed blended pilot price (after 20% onboarding credit): $17.6k/mo for three months
- Dedicated pool staging + hosted fallback: adds operational overhead ~ $1.8k/mo (one-time config + monitoring)

Ask: we need VP/CFO-level clearance to approve a non-standard blended pilot rate + onboarding credit and to allow bundled staged packaging under a single SOW. This will be a short-term ARR uplift if we expand, but margin is tighter for the pilot. Please advise whether you are comfortable with the 20% credit and the blended rate floor.

Notes: Procurement will request an explicit overage band and a one-time onboarding milestone to trigger the dedicated pool provisioning. Also, include a 30-day rollback clause in case inference quality/regression appears.

Marissa
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

2) Approve blended pilot rate at $17.6k/mo conditional on two guardrails:
   - Explicit token overage band at +40% triggers move to month-to-month at list prices until re-contracting.
   - A signed commitment to a post-pilot evaluation meeting and intent-to-purchase signal (non-binding) so we can prioritize capacity.
3) Approve packaging under single SOW with staged billing and a clear provisioning milestone (onboarding payment) before Dedicated pool spin-up.

Finance/legal items for Ben/Karthik: please prepare a short amendment template that captures the above guardrails, the rollback clause, and the DocuSign-ready SOW.
